picks.name: Kotoa
picks.source_note: Wah Wah 45s already seeded. New artist discovery -- first vinyl pressing compiling their two 2026 digital EPs.
picks.bio: "Earthwise / Out of the Dark" (November 13, 2026, Wah Wah 45s, cat. WAHLP039) is the first vinyl release for South East London five-piece Kotoa, compiling their two 2026 digital EPs (produced by Benedic Lamdin, aka Nostalgia 77) into a 10-track LP spanning dub, trip hop and African-inspired jazz.
picks.why_listen: Warm, horn-and-rhythm-driven jazz with a dub undertow -- a good organic, live-band change of texture in a set.

picks.name: Grand River
picks.source_note: Editions Mego already seeded. New artist discovery -- her first album for the label since 2023's "All Above."
picks.bio: "Temporary" (November 20, 2026, Editions Mego) is the new album from Aimee Portioli, aka Grand River -- a Dutch-Italian, Berlin-based composer mixing synths (Buchla Easel, DX7, MS-20) with acoustic instruments, led by the single "Let me know when you're pure."
picks.why_listen: Atmospheric yet rhythmically complex ambient/experimental composition -- good for a set's more spacious, textural stretches.
